what: Humana is one of the largest providers of Medicare Advantage health plans in the United States, the private alternative to government Medicare for older Americans. Through CenterWell it also owns primary care clinics, home health services and a pharmacy.
customers: Americans over 65 on Medicare Advantage plans, Medicaid members, and military families under TRICARE.
money: Medicare Advantage, Medicaid and military health plans
primary care clinics, home health and pharmacy
moat: Scale in Medicare Advantage combined with owning the clinics that treat its own members, which lets it manage cost rather than just pay claims.
risks: Medical costs have risen faster than the government payments it receives
Net margin of about 1% leaves no room for cost surprises
Star ratings cuts reduce the bonus payments it earns per member
Medicare Advantage payment rules are set by the government and can change
opportunities: Analysts see about 34% upside from current levels
Owning clinics lets it capture the saving when care is managed better
The population turning 65 grows every year
watch: The medical loss ratio and Star ratings for the coming plan year.
